data.long_meaning: Derived from the Hebrew words יָהוָה (YHWH), meaning 'Jehovah' and שעָה (sa'ah), meaning 'salvation'. In the Old Testament, Hoshea was the last king of the Northern Kingdom of Israel before the Assyrian exile. The name Hoshea carries the meaning “Jehovah is Salvation” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Hoshea usually hope their child will grow to embody jehovah is salvation and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_hebrew.name: הושע
in_hebrew.meaning: ישועה הוא שמו, הושע פירושו ישועה או הצלה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: הושע הוא שם עברי שפירושו ישועה או הצלה. הוא מורכב משתי מילים: הושע ויהו, שפירושו הוא האל יהוה הוא ישועה. הושע היה גם שם של בן נושע, מלך ישראל האחרון, שנזכר בתנ"ך.

in_greek.name: Ωσηε
in_greek.meaning: σωτηρία ἐστιν ὁ ὄνομα, Ὡσηε σημαίνει σωτηρία

in_latin.name: Osee

in_english.name: Hoshea
in_english.long_meaning: Hoshea is a Hebrew name that means 'God is salvation' or 'deliverance'. It is derived from the Hebrew words 'hoshea' (ישועה) meaning 'salvation' and 'El' (אל) meaning 'God'. In the Bible, Hoshea was the name of the last king of Israel and a prophet in the Old Testament. The name has been used in Christian tradition to signify spiritual salvation through faith in God.

data.cultural_impact: Hoshea was a significant king in Israelite history as he ruled during the tumultuous period leading up to the Assyrian exile. He was the last king of the Northern Kingdom of Israel, which had been repeatedly conquered and regained its independence several times. During Hoshea's reign, the region was once again invaded and this time, the Israelites were exiled to Assyria. The name Hoshea, which means 'salvation', might have been a prophetic reminder of the ultimate salvation that would come through the Messiah.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Hoshea holds deep spiritual significance as it is derived from the Hebrew words for 'Jehovah' and 'salvation'. This name emphasizes the belief in a God who saves, and highlights the Israelites' reliance on God during times of distress. The name Hoshea serves as a reminder of the ultimate salvation that comes through faith in God, and the ongoing hope for redemption and restoration. Whether in biblical times or today, the name Hoshea continues to inspire faith and trust in the saving power of God.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Hoshea, meaning "salvation," embodies the promise of God's deliverance. It is a reminder that just as God saved the Israelites from captivity in Egypt, so too does He save us from our own bondage to sin. This name instills hope and trust in the power of divine intervention.

biblical_reference.note: Hoshea was the last king of Israel, mentioned in 2 Kings 15:32 and 17:1.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Hoshea was the last king of Israel before the Assyrian conquest in 722 BCE. The name Hoshea carried significant spiritual weight in that era.
historical_references.context: During the reign of Hoshea, Shalmaneser V of Assyria invaded Israel and placed Hoshea on the throne. However, Hoshea soon rebelled against Assyria and sought help from Egypt. This led to the final Assyrian conquest of Israel and the end of the Northern Kingdom.

historical_references.reference: Hoshea is mentioned in the Old Testament book of 2 Kings and the prophetic books of Isaiah and Micah.
historical_references.context: In the Old Testament, Hoshea is portrayed as a wicked king who led Israel into idolatry and rebellion against Assyria. The prophets Isaiah and Micah condemned Hoshea and foretold the coming Assyrian conquest.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Hoshea is of Hebrew origin, meaning 'salvation'. In modern context, it is commonly associated with biblical studies due to the presence of a king named Hoshea in the Old Testament. The name is also relevant in Hebrew language revival efforts as it is a part of the rich linguistic heritage of the Jewish people. Additionally, the name has gained significance in Judaic studies as scholars explore the historical and cultural context of the Jewish monarchies and their rulers, including King Hoshea.

name_in_real_life.story: A devoted Christian named Sarah Hoshea in Jerusalem, Israel credits much of their spiritual journey to their name Hoshea, which means "Jehovah is Salvation". They believe their name has been a blessing and reminder of God's presence in their life.
